sources.headline: Crews battle Albany apartment fire
sources.excerpt: Firefighters responded to a two-alarm fire at an apartment building on Central Avenue in Albany shortly after 6 a.m. Tuesday. Officials said 14 residents were displaced and one firefighter was treated for a minor injury.

sources.headline: Overnight fire damages Albany apartments
sources.excerpt: A fire damaged a three-story apartment building on Central Avenue. The Albany Fire Department said the cause is under investigation.

sources.headline: Residents displaced following Albany blaze
sources.excerpt: The American Red Cross is assisting 14 displaced residents after Tuesday's fire on Central Avenue, according to a Red Cross spokesperson.

sources.headline: Schenectady council approves $98.4 million budget
sources.excerpt: The Schenectady City Council voted 5-2 Monday night to approve a $98.4 million budget for 2027. The plan raises the property tax levy by 1.9 percent. Council member Jane Ortiz, who voted no, said the increase was too high.

sources.headline: Schenectady budget passes with tax increase
sources.excerpt: Mayor Gary McCarthy said the budget protects city services. The budget passed 5-2.

sources.headline: Lane closures on Interstate 890 in Schenectady County
sources.excerpt: Motorists should expect alternating lane closures on I-890 eastbound between Exit 4C and Exit 5 from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Wednesday through Friday for bridge joint repairs.

sources.headline: Troy water main break leaves hundreds without service
sources.excerpt: About 300 homes in Troy lost water service after a main break on River Street, city officials said. A boil water advisory is in effect.

sources.headline: Water main break hits Troy's River Street
sources.excerpt: A water main break on River Street affected roughly 500 customers, according to a utility spokesperson. Repairs are expected to finish by Thursday.

sources.headline: Magnitude 6.1 earthquake strikes off coast of northern Chile
sources.excerpt: A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck off the coast of northern Chile early Wednesday, the U.S. Geological Survey said. There were no immediate reports of damage, and no tsunami warning was issued.
